name: local_db
description: Query local SQLite databases. Run SELECT queries to read data, or CREATE/INSERT to modify.

manual.overview: Use when you need to query or modify a local SQLite database file. Best for structured data stored in .db or .sqlite files.

examples.description: Insert a row into the logs table

tips: Prefer SELECT for reads; use CREATE/INSERT only when you need to modify
Sanitize user input to avoid SQL injection; use parameterized queries when possible
Use LIMIT in SELECT to cap result size
db_path must be an absolute or valid relative path to the .db file
edge_cases: Database may be locked if another process has it open
Invalid SQL or missing tables will raise errors
Schema differences may cause type mismatches in results

executor.command: python -c "import sqlite3, json, sys; conn=sqlite3.connect('{{args.db_path}}'); conn.row_factory=sqlite3.Row; cur=conn.execute('{{args.query}}'); rows=[dict(r) for r in cur.fetchmany({{args.limit}})]; print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2, default=str)); conn.close()"
